name: KEY CONTROL
author: izicubed
description: Physical two-key USB button keyboards as per-pilot lap marshals, with two work modes. MANUAL: the timer's own RSSI laps are suppressed - every lap comes from the buttons (key 1 adds, key 2 deletes). SEMI: the timer counts laps as usual and key presses confirm them inside a +-threshold window (default 2 s, editable in the panel header) - green = confirmed, yellow = unconfirmed timer lap, blue = button press with no timer lap (a manual lap is added at the press), red = deleted (strikethrough time). Keyboards are read by a forwarder script on a remote Raspberry Pi and forwarded over Socket.IO; the plugin can re-point the forwarder at itself via the Key Control IP setting (forwarder control endpoint on port 8737, URL persisted). Keyboard N maps to the Nth occupied seat of the current heat (R1/R3/R6/R8 -> KB1..KB4), with fixed-seat overrides and a panel-driven Calibrate flow that binds keyboards to channels by pressing a key on each in turn. Works on RotorHazard 4.4+.
